title: [DEV] aaps cannot load the settings and restarts after update to latest dev
symptom: After updating to the latest dev build, the app crashes within seconds. Clearing cache or data does not help; restoring settings causes a crash. Switching to virtual pump stops crashes, but setting back to DanaRv2 causes crashes again. The issue occurs on Xiaomi 11T Pro with Android 12 and MIUI 13.0.7.
cause: The crashes are related to missing Bluetooth permission, likely due to a MIUI-specific issue.
fix: A fix for the latest MIUI was added in the dev branch; the user confirmed the issue is resolved after testing again.
evidence_quote: i see crashes related to missing BT permission
